_meta.note: Pluggable external evidence corpus. Replace these illustrative reference figures with verified values from CDP, official filings, or audited prior reports. Records are matched to claims by (company_id, metric_key, year).

quality_values.verified: Sourced from a verified third-party filing/dataset (CDP, audited report). Counts as production-grade ground truth.
quality_values.self_reported: From the company's own other filings (assigned automatically to cross-report evidence, not stored here).
quality_values.illustrative: Placeholder value for demos — NOT a real figure. Must not be presented as verified.
quality_values.unverified: Default when a record omits quality.

record_schema.quality: string (verified | illustrative | unverified) — machine-readable trust tier
